 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # The four separated 4x4 layers are overlaid with color priority 9 > 4 > 8 > 5.
    tiles = [[[grid[r][c+i] for i in range(4)] for r in range(4)] for c in (0, 5, 10, 15)]
